name: Homelander
creator: kaizen
description:
**Features:**

- Custom model and textures
- Custom animations
- Custom Voice-over
- New VFX
- New SFX
- Custom, animated loading screen and in-game icons
- Milk from... don't worry about it
- A-Train and a lot of Yummers
﻿

Now this is America's greatest supe- custom skin. I hope. Features a fully custom animated Homelander, complete with facial expressions (as best as I could make them), laser eyes and his trusted teammate, A-Train. Laser your opponents, fly around them, trap them in the Seven Tower*, drink your milk, and say yummers over and over.

As a bonus, the loading screen is shiny and animated, and you can use it with any of Camille's skins or chromas, it will always appear as Homelander.

Also, I made a special chroma, featuring TURKLANDER.

You think it should have been done on a different champion? Well, as the man himself would put it... "I'm the Homelander, I can do whatever the f*ck I want".

I've made two versions. Homelander and Turklander, inspired by a meme. Only use ONE at a time!
